verdict.rationale: Agent Mode is documented as a natural-language agent inside Postman, so the MCP-client axis applies, but nothing shows Postman connecting to external MCP servers and calling their tools. The MCP-related evidence covers adjacent capabilities: registering MCP servers with the Fabric gateway to share with a team, generating MCP servers with the MCP Generator, and an official Postman MCP server (server role). None of these show Postman itself consuming MCP tools.
